final: WITH patient_group AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.TAT2 / NULLIF(l.TAT, 0)) AS patient_avg FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_group AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg) AS sex_avg FROM patient_group GROUP BY SEX), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(sex_avg) AS overall_avg FROM sex_group) SELECT s.SEX, s.sex_avg, s.sex_avg - o.overall_avg FROM sex_group AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE s.sex_avg > o.overall_avg
